body: 2026-10-16 (252b629). Setup-tokens are inference-only (V2 failed), so usage is read from one /v1/messages call (smallest model, max_tokens 1) via the anthropic-ratelimit-unified-5h/7d utilization/reset/status headers. Runs only when asked (see rule rul_01a147bb8e9b7c25840ac540ef0cc87b). Supersedes D7 ('--login auto only if V2 passes'): --login auto ships, picking among the home login and every fitting login with the unchanged pick package policy. Known cost: with --login auto a token_cmd runs twice (probe + launch).
title: Logins D14: usage for token logins by a 1-token probe
